verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Tailscale has a programmable surface: tailnet automation via infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks and integrations, a documented CLI, and a community mention of API keys. A community user also reports those keys expire after 60 days, which limits unattended automation. Nothing shows the API matches the admin UI feature-for-feature, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at common paths. Missing for 10: documented API reference showing UI parity, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence that UI-only features such as the visual policy editor and user role management are API-accessible, long-lived non-interactive credentials.
